title: The invoice that wasn't
summary: A fake overdue invoice reaches three people at Kestrel Logistics. One opens it. An hour later the HR and Finance folders are encrypted. Find patient zero, trace the attack, contain it and choose a backup to restore.

title: The night shift download
summary: An engineer who has just resigned to join a competitor badges into an empty office at 01:47. Build a timeline from badge, VPN, Git, USB and DLP records, and handle it the right way: evidence first, then HR and Legal.

title: Exam day outage
summary: Five minutes into an online exam, the school's portal stops answering, and an extortion email arrives. Tell real students from attack traffic, name the three kinds of flood, and choose how to get the exam back.

title: The hacked web shop
summary: NimbuMart's web server is busy and sending data out. Follow the attacker from SQL injection to a web shell, a hidden backdoor and a command server.

title: The key in the commit
summary: A deploy key with admin rights sat in an old Git commit. The repo went public for one evening. By 02:00 someone had copied customer data, made a backdoor admin and started 20 crypto-miners. Trace it, shut it down and fix the root cause.
